# Gradle Wrapper provenance

`gradle-wrapper.jar` is sourced from the official `gradle/gradle` GitHub repository at the stable `v8.13.0` tag (Apache-2.0). No project-specific code has been inserted into the jar.

Official Gradle 8.13 SHA-256 values:

- Wrapper JAR: `81a82aaea5abcc8ff68b3dfcb58b3c3c429378efd98e7433460610fecd7ae45f`
- Gradle 8.13 binary distribution ZIP: `20f1b1176237254a6fc204d8434196fa11a4cfb387567519c61556e8710aed78`

Source: https://gradle.org/release-checksums/

The official jar is committed as a binary only in the canonical GitHub repository. The lightweight local source ZIP has no Gradle wrapper JAR; clone GitHub for the full wrapper or supply Gradle 8.13. There is no Android SDK or APK bundled with this repository.
